points.name: apps.timer.recent_caption_refresh
points.interpretation: when the recent caption needs creating during a main-page refresh, this call sets the recent.timer translation.

evidence: The show-run routine uses the main state at 0x2010fcc8; offsets 28 and 36 hold the run and main views respectively. It creates the run view if absent, then changes the listed flags on both views. The show-main routine applies the reverse operations. Refresh can recreate the recent caption with a separate label call.
scope: Specific recorded calls with the main state active; flags on other widgets and other call paths are not covered.
limitations: Suppressing or changing flag operations may cause both views to overlap or make the UI inconsistent. The state and descriptor-root slots do not establish thread quiescence; publication and rollback of shared entries require system-wide quiescence. Static analysis only; device behavior and recovery are unverified.
